name: io.github.sunholo-data/parse
title: AILANG Parse
description: Deterministic DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/PDF parser: track changes, comments, headers, footers, merged cells.

environmentVariables.name: DOCPARSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AILANG Parse API key (dp_...). Optional — the bridge auto-loads keys saved at ~/.config/ailang-parse/credentials.json. Get one from https://www.sunholo.com/ailang-parse/

environmentVariables.name: AILANG_PARSE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the hosted MCP endpoint. Defaults to https://docparse.ailang.sunholo.com/mcp/
